prompt_en: Create a photorealistic fashion editorial inside a working Victorian palm-house conservatory during hard summer rain. The single human subject is one unmistakably adult woman whose appearance is to follow the supplied reference image. Image 1 serves only as general visible appearance guidance for an original adult subject; body, outfit, pose, and environment are newly authored for this scene. Show her complete figure from crown to footwear, with the hem, slit endpoint, securely covered pelvis, opaque bodice, both hands, and handwheel all inside the frame. She stands on a narrow grated maintenance bridge and uses both hands to turn a large verdigris handwheel, visibly opening overhead ventilation louvers as warm mist curls through giant cycads and wet copper pipes. She wears one tailored, opaque, floor-length dress with exactly one finished thigh-high side slit. A fitted opaque bodice fully and stably covers both breasts, and a continuous opaque waist-and-hip section fully and stably covers the pelvis throughout the turning stance. The constructed side opening exposes one leg to the upper thigh. Its visible endpoint sits below the covered pelvis; two continuous skirt panels meet there, and their straight finished stitched vertical edges descend together to the hem. The dress remains continuous across the waist and above the endpoint, while the complete opposite side and full hem stay visibly closed. The uninterrupted outer dress is the sole visible lower garment; intact tailoring keeps both panels joined above the endpoint, and calm air leaves the engineered slit geometry clearly readable. Use a level full-figure three-quarter view with the slit side unobscured. Rain-streaked glass, receding iron trusses, wet metal, condensation, and soft storm daylight create layered depth while preserving crisp garment-edge visibility. Natural anatomy, convincing hand-to-wheel contact, real fabric weight, photorealistic skin texture, and physically plausible materials.
